items.heading: Sishwala with Sidvudvu
details: Key ingredients: corn meal, pumpkin, water
Cook corn meal with water into a thick, smooth porridge.
Simmer pumpkin separately until soft and mashable.
Mash the pumpkin and stir it partly into the porridge for sweetness.
Serve warm as a filling staple.

items.heading: Sitfwala Beef Stew
details: Key ingredients: beef, onion, tomato, leafy greens
Brown beef chunks with onion.
Add tomato and enough water to simmer.
Cook until the beef is tender, then stir in leafy greens.
Serve the stew over maize porridge.
